battle.name: 572-591年拜占庭-薩珊戰爭
battle.theater: 亞美尼亞高原與安納托利亞東境
battle.brief: 572年科斯勞二世越境開戰，戰事在亞美尼亞高原與安納托利亞東境拉鋸十九年。拜占庭的羅馬重步兵傳統化成斯庫塔托的長矛盾牆與卡塔夫拉克托重裝步兵線，靠主題民兵與禁軍的兵源補充頂住薩珊弓騎優勢；582年達拉失守、586年薩塔拉反敗為勝、590年提奧多西奧波利斯夜襲燒營是三個樞紐。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 572年開戰時，東方帝國由查士丁二世坐鎮，軍政大權卻握在共治皇帝莫里斯手裡。真正的野戰骨幹已非早期羅馬的世襲軍團，而是莫里斯整頓後的主題制民兵：卡帕拉提亞、基利基亞、亞美尼亞、色雷等主題按地緣徵召兵員，首都近郊另設禁軍tagmata，每支部隊編制約五千人，作戰時把禁軍與主力主題兵拼成野戰軍，交由戰略家與各鎮守官率領，前線還有亞美尼亞王國的附庸兵、色雷斯的黑海雇兵與阿拉伯加珊系部族的雇騎。帝國的戰力靠安納托利亞沿岸到君士坦丁堡的航運、駝隊與徵發維持，遠征軍一旦被切斷補給或碰上疫病就會自行崩解。薩珊一方由霍爾米茲四世與科斯勞二世父子相繼調度，骨幹是spah騎兵團、善射的弓騎手與披魚鱗甲的重甲突擊騎兵，中央保留九千人規模的「不死者」近衛，另有亞美尼亞、拉吉卡與波斯灣諸屬國輸出的步兵與援軍；薩珊作戰習慣以圍城與騎兵機動壓迫邊境，而不是硬吃帝國的方陣。
countriesEn: When the war opened in 572 the eastern empire was nominally under Justin II, but the effective direction of its war effort lay with his co-emperor Maurice. The real field strength was no longer the hereditary legions of early Rome but the themed levies Maurice had reorganised: the themes of Cappadocia, Cilicia, Armenia and Thrace each drew men from their own districts, while the tagmata quartered around the capital, each tagma notionally about five thousand men, provided the standing core. In the field the tagmata were combined with picked thematic troops into an operational army commanded by strategoi and theme officers, supported on the frontier by the levies of the Armenian client kingdom, auxiliaries recruited from the Black Sea Chersonese, and Arab Ghassanid cavalry. Byzantine strength rested on coastal shipping linking the Anatolian shore to Constantinople, on mule and camel trains, and on requisition; a field army cut off from supply or struck by disease dissolved on its own. The Sasanian side was directed in turn by Hormizd IV and his son Khosrow II, its core being the spah, expert horse-archers and lamellar-armoured lancers, with a central guard of about nine thousand 'Immortals', plus infantry and auxiliaries supplied by Armenia, Lazica and the Persian Gulf dependencies. Sasanian practice was to press the frontier with sieges and mounted manoeuvre rather than to assault an imperial phalanx head-on.
people: 薩珊方面的核心人物是科斯勞二世（591至628年在位），他以弒父之名即位後立刻把矛頭指向拜占庭，戰事目標多由他定奪，戰場執行則交給呼羅珊與東部各省的將領。拜占庭方面，青年莫里斯在查士丁二世末期就主持東境防務，573年之後接任共治皇帝並改革軍制，是這場持久戰真正的策劃者；將領之中，出身東羅馬的拉卡佩諾斯元帥在571至573年率軍攻入波斯亞美尼亞並占領首都德溫，隨後因疫病與薩珊反擊被迫撤回，同行的還有日後成為皇帝的赫拉克略，他以青年軍官身分初戰陣前，此後數十年都在東部邊境累積經驗。591年前夕完成翻盤的是宦官出身、與亞美尼亞馬米科尼安王族有親緣的將軍納爾塞斯，他在590年提奧多西奧波利斯之圍中以夜襲縱火燒營破敵，隨後深入波斯亞美尼亞攻陷德溫；586年薩塔拉之役則由西塔斯與瓦漢·馬米科尼安聯手取勝，把薩珊名將巴赫拉姆·喬賓的前途逼到盡頭，那位名將隨即出奔君士坦丁堡並受洗皈依基督教。亞美尼亞王瓦漢·馬米科尼安則是兩邊都倚重的第三方，他既助拜占庭作戰，也曾在586年協助鎮壓科斯勞之弟霍爾米茲的叛亂。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Sasanian side was Khosrow II, reigning from 591 to 628, who had seized the throne by the murder of his father and turned at once on Byzantium; the overall aims of the war were his, though the campaigns themselves were executed by his generals out of Khorasan and the eastern provinces. On the Byzantine side the young Maurice had already directed the eastern defences at the end of Justin II's reign, became co-emperor after 573 and sole emperor in 582, and was the real planner of a long attritional war. Among the generals, the eastern Roman magnate Romanos Lakapenos carried the campaign of 571 to 573 into Persian Armenia and captured its capital Dvin, then withdrew before plague and a Sasanian counter-stroke; Heraclius, the future emperor, served in that army as a young officer and first saw action there, and would spend the following decades accumulating experience on the eastern frontier. The turnaround of 591 was the work of Narses, a eunuch general of Armenian origin and a relative of the Armenian Mamikonian dynasty, who in 590 broke the siege of Theodosiopolis with a night fire-raid against the Sasanian camp and then pushed into Persian Armenia and took Dvin. The victory of Satala in 586 was won by Sittas together with Vahan Mamikonian, and it ruined the Sasanian commander Bahram Chobin, who deserted to Constantinople and was baptised. Vahan Mamikonian himself was a third party relied on by both sides: he fought for Byzantium and in 586 helped suppress the revolt of Khosrow's brother Hormizd.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬重步兵是這場戰爭的祖型，而非它的同代人。公元前一世紀的軍團重步兵以分段鎧甲配大盾立陣，兩個半世紀之後，帝國的野戰步兵在裝備上已由環節甲過渡到鎖子甲、鱗甲與後來的克里瓦尼翁硬片甲，盾也從大橢圓盾縮小成斯庫塔托與卡塔夫拉克托使用的長圓盾。572年之後真正站在亞美尼亞高原最前線的，是拜占庭的斯庫塔托長矛方陣與卡塔夫拉克托重裝部隊；卡面那句「羅馬的戰力靠補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝」在實戰中完全成立：571至573年遠征德溫的是一支由主題兵、禁軍與雇騎拼成的混合大軍，卻被疫病與斷糧拖垮；真正扭轉戰局的是586年薩塔拉的夜襲與590年提奧多西奧波利斯的縱火，而不是任何一套甲胄。對面的薩珊裝備另有體系：重甲突擊騎兵披魚鱗甲、持長柄騎槍與圓盾，弓騎手用高身複合弓在遠距離拋射，隨軍工匠維護的擲射器械與攻城武器用來對付堡壘與營壘；運輸靠馬匹、驢騾與雙峰駝，沿海段以船連接君士坦丁堡與特拉比松再轉陸路，這條線決定了雙方遠征的極限。
kitsEn: The heavy infantryman on the card is the ancestor of the armies in this war rather than their contemporary. The legionary of the first century BC fought in a line of segmented armour behind a large shield; two and a half centuries later the imperial field infantry had moved from ring-mail and scale to the klivanion of hardened lames, and their shield had shrunk from the great oval scutum to the smaller oblong shields carried by the skoutatoi and the kataphraktoi. After 572 the men who actually stood at the front on the Armenian plateau were the spear wall of the skoutatoi and the fully armoured kataphraktoi. The card's claim that Roman power rested on manning and supply rather than on armour holds exactly here: the army that took Dvin in 571 to 573 was a mixed host of thematics, tagmata and hired cavalry, and it was broken down by plague and want of supply, not by the enemy's equipment. What turned the war was the night attack at Satala in 586 and the fire-raid at Theodosiopolis in 590. The Sasanian equipment belonged to a different system: cataphract lancers in scale armour with lance and round shield, horse-archers using tall composite bows for long-range shooting, and a train of artillery and siege engines kept in the field by attached craftsmen for use against fortresses and camps. Movement depended on horses, mules and Bactrian camels, with shipping joining Constantinople to Trebizond and the rest of the route carried by road.
tactics: 薩珊的戰術核心是弓騎對射與假退誘敵。弓騎手在陣前維持數百步至上千步的射程，不與帝國方陣接觸；敵軍若追擊，便佯裝潰退把它們拉出陣形，再由重甲突擊騎兵從側翼與背後衝擊，或用投射武器覆蓋退兵之路。攻堡壘時則集中擲射武器與圍城，逼迫守軍在補給耗盡後出城決戰。拜占庭這邊把主力收攏在斯庫塔托的長矛盾牆後面，弓手與標槍手在前吸收騎射，敵騎衝擊散亂之後由後方的卡塔夫拉克托與精騎收拾戰果，騎兵布置在兩翼待機，整套部署的思想在六世紀的戰術手冊《戰略論》中已有系統整理。雙方的野戰勝負多由夜色與地形決定：586年薩塔拉，拜占庭方面在西塔斯率領下以佯敗把薩珊大軍引入山間狹道，再夜襲其營；590年提奧多西奧波利斯城下，納爾塞斯故意讓薩珊王與王子入城，把精銳留在城外宿營的薩珊軍在夜裡付之一炬。守方則靠堡壘的堅固與糧秣的儲備拉長戰線，把敵人拖在城下，等敵軍的援兵、補給與疫病替自己決定勝負。
tacticsEn: The core of Sasanian method was archery at range and feigned retreat. The horse-archers held the front at several hundred to a thousand paces without closing with the imperial line; if the enemy pressed, they would feign flight, draw the pursuers out of formation and then bring the armoured lancers in on the flank and the rear, or cover the withdrawal with massed missile fire. Against fortifications they concentrated artillery and blockade, forcing the garrison to leave its walls once supplies ran out. The Byzantines instead massed behind the spear-and-shield wall of the skoutatoi, with archers and javelin-men in front absorbing the shooting, the kataphraktoi and the best of the cavalry waiting behind to exploit the disorder of a broken assault, and the mounted troops held back on the wings. The pattern is systematised in the sixth-century tactical manual known as the Strategikon. Decisive results were usually settled by night and by ground: at Satala in 586 Sittas feigned defeat, drew the Sasanian host into a defile in the mountains and fell on its camp by night; before Theodosiopolis in 590 Narses deliberately allowed the Persian king and his son into the city and then fired the camp where the main body had quartered. The defence relied on the endurance of walls and provisions, tying the enemy down until their own supplies and the weather decided for them.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但骨架清楚：572年開戰，591年議和，全長十九年，中間以575年的一份五年期和約劃出一段停火，據記載其內容是亞美尼亞西部歸薩珊、拜占庭方面支付以金諾米斯馬計的歲幣。572至573年拜占庭遠征曾攻入波斯亞美尼亞並占領首都德溫，但主力因疫病與斷糧撤回，此役之後雙方各有敗績。582年薩珊名將巴赫拉姆·喬賓率軍奪下邊境重鎮達拉、阿米達與卡利尼庫姆，拜占庭邊軍退守不設防的邊界，這是全役最丟臉的一次崩潰；586年薩塔拉之役薩珊遠征軍被摧毀，與之對應的拜占庭野戰軍，在莫里斯時期是禁軍加精銳主題兵合計約數萬人，薩珊的中央近衛「不死者」編制記載為九千人，帝國禁軍tagmata每支部隊約五千人。戰線自幼發拉底斯河上游一路延伸到高加索山脈，綿延逾一千公里，任何一方都難以同時支援兩處。提奧多西奧波利斯與德溫之間的道路單程約三百公里以上，遠征全靠步行與畜力，冬季的亞美尼亞高原幾乎無物資可取。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few but the outline is clear: the war ran from 572 to 591, nineteen years, interrupted by a five-year truce in 575 which, on the terms recorded, ceded western Armenia to the Sasanians against a tribute paid in gold nomismata. The Byzantine expedition of 571 to 573 reached Persian Armenia and occupied the capital Dvin, but the main body was withdrawn after plague and the failure of supply, and both sides suffered defeats afterwards. In 582 the Sasanian general Bahram Chobin took the frontier strongholds of Dara, Amida and Callinicum, and the Byzantine frontier troops retreated to the undefended border line, the worst collapse of the whole war. In 586 the Sasanian field army was destroyed at Satala. The Byzantine operational force in Maurice's time, tagmata plus picked thematic troops, ran to tens of thousands; the central Sasanian guard, the 'Immortals', is recorded at nine thousand, and each Byzantine tagma at about five thousand. The frontier ran from the upper Euphrates to the Caucasus, more than a thousand kilometres, and neither side could easily support two points on it at once. The road between Theodosiopolis and Dvin was over three hundred kilometres each way, the marches were made on foot and by animal power, and the Armenian plateau in winter offered almost nothing to forage.
cause: 直接導火線出在571至572年間的薩珊王位繼承。571年雙方剛重訂邊境和約，次年霍爾米茲四世卻被宮廷政變弒殺，動手的正是他的兒子科斯勞二世與生母、帕提亞公主舒珊杜赫特。新王把父親之死算到拜占庭頭上：坊間說法指莫里斯曾默許甚至鼓勵這場政變，普羅科匹烏斯又記錄了莫里斯與舒珊杜赫特之間的私情說法。無論真偽，這套指控正好提供了開戰的名分。深層原因則是邊境體系本身的長期緊張：亞美尼亞與拉吉卡等附庸王國的歸屬、信仰不同的教派衝突，以及薩珊王位繼承的合法性問題，都是歷年糾紛。科斯勞二世年輕，急於鞏固新君位，一旦父親留下的宮廷集團被指受外力支持，他便以恢復秩序為名，先用一場邊境戰役試探帝國虛實，隨即全面開戰。
causeEn: The immediate spark lay in the Sasanian succession of 571 to 572. The two powers had just renewed their frontier treaty in 571, but early in 572 Hormizd IV was killed in a palace coup carried out by his own son Khosrow II and by the boy's mother, the Parthian princess Shushandukht. The new king charged the murder to Byzantium: the usual account is that Maurice had acquiesced in, or even encouraged, the coup, and Procopius reports a further claim that Maurice had pursued the queen mother. Whether true or not, the accusation gave him the pretext he needed. Underneath lay the chronic strain of the frontier system itself: the ownership of client kingdoms such as Armenia and Lazica, the clash of faiths, and the standing question of legitimacy in Sasanian succession politics. Khosrow II was young and eager to secure a new reign; once the court group around his father could be branded as backed from outside, he opened with a limited frontier operation to test the empire's strength, and then went to war.
impact: 十九年拉鋸留下的，是一套成熟的邊境體系和一代老兵。591年薩珊歸還亞美尼亞，瓦漢·馬米科尼安重登亞美尼亞王位，達拉等堡壘重回帝國控制，東境回到開戰前的狀態，雙方也得到十一年的相對平靜。對拜占庭而言，這場戰爭把莫里斯的軍制改革逼到完成：主題制的民兵成為野戰主力，禁軍的戰略家與bandon編制在實戰中被反覆修正，遠征亞美尼亞的經驗則寫進《戰略論》一類的部署手冊裡，帝國從此習慣以縱深、工事與時間換取邊境安全，而不是追求一場決定性的野戰決戰。對薩珊而言，雖然在591年議和時居於劣勢，其弓騎與重甲突擊的組合仍然是壓迫邊堡的有力工具，而正是591年的勝利讓觀察者看清了拜占庭付出的代價：菲卡斯的政變把莫里斯送上斷頭台，也讓科斯勞二世失去了攻略亞美尼亞的最好時機。真正被這場戰爭消耗的是兩國的財政與兵源，幾乎所有記載都把602年開打的那場更殘酷的戰爭，看作這十九年的直接延續。
impactEn: Nineteen years of attrition left a matured frontier system and a generation of veterans. In 591 the Sasanians returned Armenia, Vahan Mamikonian was restored to its throne, Dara and the other fortresses came back to imperial control, the eastern border reverted to its pre-war line, and both sides enjoyed roughly eleven years of relative quiet. For Byzantium the war forced Maurice's military reforms to completion: the themed levies became the backbone of the field army, the command of the strategoi and the bandon structure were revised in the light of experience, and the lessons of the Armenian marches were written into manuals of deployment such as the Strategikon. From then on the empire was accustomed to buy frontier security with depth, works and time rather than with a single decisive field battle. The Sasanians, though they ended 591 on the weaker side, still held the most effective instrument for pressing the border in the combination of horse-archers and armoured lancers. The Byzantine success of 591 also made the cost of that victory plain: Phocas' coup cost Maurice his head, and it cost Khosrow II the best moment to take Armenia. What the war really consumed was the treasury and the manpower of both states, and nearly every account treats the far crueller war that began in 602 as the direct continuation of these nineteen years.
result: 591年的和約是全役終點：薩珊方面同意歸還所占領地、恢復亞美尼亞王國、並支付一筆以金諾米斯馬計的賠款，邊境大致回到572年之前的走向，達拉等關鍵堡壘仍由拜占庭掌握，征戰多年的亞美尼亞貴族也沒有得到任何領土補償。拜占庭方面在591年同一年迎來宮廷政變，莫里斯被菲卡斯推翻並遭殺害，亞美尼亞因而重新落入帝國控制，瓦漢·馬米科尼安得以復位，雙方的軍事計畫都被打亂。科斯勞二世在591年之後仍想利用對方的內亂，甚至試圖扶植自己年幼的兒子登上拜占庭的皇位，但薩珊的內部同樣不穩：591年科斯勞三世的即位與隨即被廢，連同宮廷對莫里斯被廢一事的反應，都說明這位皇帝並未因邊境得手而鞏固政權。凱旋並沒有帶來和平的基盤，帝國的邊境依然長久暴露在薩珊騎兵之下，591到602年間的停火不過是一次暫歇。
resultEn: The treaty of 591 ended the war. The Sasanians agreed to give back the territory they had taken, to restore the Armenian kingdom and to pay an indemnity reckoned in gold nomismata; the frontier broadly returned to its pre-572 line, the key fortresses such as Dara remained in Byzantine hands, and the Armenian nobility, after long years of war, received no territorial compensation. In the same year Byzantium was convulsed by a palace coup: Maurice was overthrown by Phocas and killed, Armenia returned to imperial control, Vahan Mamikonian was put back on his throne, and the military plans of both sides were thrown into confusion. Khosrow II still hoped to exploit the Byzantine civil war after 591 and even tried to promote his own young son to the Byzantine throne, but the Sasanian state was no more stable: the accession and the swift removal of Khosrow III in 591, together with the court reactions to the news of Maurice's fall, show that the shah was no more secure for his frontier successes than Maurice had been. The victory brought no durable peace. The frontier remained permanently exposed to Sasanian cavalry, and the pause between 591 and 602 was only an intermission.
